h1: B2 Rangsit Boutique & Budget Hotel — new, clean budget rooms in the Rangsit area at a price that works
intro: If you're after an affordable stay in the Rangsit-Khlong Luang area that still feels new and clean — whether you're dropping a student at one of the nearby universities, stopping overnight before an early Don Muang flight, or just passing through and want a comfortable bed — B2 Rangsit Boutique & Budget Hotel is worth noting. It's a 3-star budget hotel in the B2 chain that opened in 2024 on Phahonyothin Road in Khlong Nueng, Khlong Luang district. 73 rooms, AC, free Wi-Fi and a 24-hour front desk, from approx. ฿550/night — and it pulls a real-review score of 8.6, which is very strong for this price band.

body.html: What lifts B2 Rangsit above the usual budget hotel is how new and clean it feels. The property only opened in 2024, so the rooms are fresh, the furnishings modern, the beds comfortable — and reviewers mention the word "clean" again and again. Many are surprised to get a room in this condition for a few hundred baht, and that's exactly what sets B2 apart from the older budget places in the same area that are starting to show their age.

Location is the other selling point. The hotel sits on Phahonyothin Road in the Khlong Luang-Rangsit area, right on a main road and easy to get in and out of. It's about 4 km from Bangkok University, around 9 km from Thammasat University's Rangsit campus, and not far from Future Park Rangsit. Most guests are parents dropping students at the nearby universities, people here on errands in Rangsit, or travelers stopping overnight before an early Don Muang flight. There's a 7-Eleven close by, which reviews repeatedly call handy for a late-night snack.

Staff are another consistent positive. Plenty of real reviews say the team is friendly and helpful, even at a late check-in. The front desk is open 24 hours so you can arrive at any time — ideal if you roll in at night or have to leave before dawn for a flight. There's a lift so you're not hauling bags up stairs, and free Wi-Fi in both the rooms and the common areas.

"Room was new and very clean for the price, comfortable bed, and staff were friendly and helpful at a late check-in. There's a 7-Eleven close by too. Great for an overnight before an early flight or dropping a kid at a Rangsit university."

In fairness, B2 Rangsit has the limits you'd expect from a budget hotel. The thing guests raise most is that sound insulation between rooms isn't great — you can hear door locks and people in the hallway, so if you're a light sleeper, pack earplugs. Some reviews also note the rooms are on the small side, and because the hotel is so new a few rooms still carry a faint paint smell. None of this is surprising at the price, but it's worth setting expectations.

A few more things to know before booking. There's no breakfast, so you'll head out to eat (there's a 7-Eleven and eateries along Phahonyothin Road). Parking is limited, so if you're self-driving at a busy time you may need to find an extra spot. Some rooms don't come with a hair dryer or toothbrush — borrow at the desk or bring your own. And a couple of reviews mention a fine for marks on the floor mats, so treat the room carefully to be safe.

Overall, B2 Rangsit Boutique & Budget Hotel scores around 8.6 out of 10 from real reviews — very high for a budget hotel. It isn't a luxury stay and doesn't pretend to be, but measured on how new and clean it is, a Phahonyothin Road location near the universities and Future Park, friendly staff, and a price that starts around ฿550 and climbs into the low thousands by season, it's hard-to-beat value in the Rangsit area — just go in prepared on noise and room size.

faqTitle: FAQ — B2 Rangsit Boutique & Budget Hotel

faq.q: Where is B2 Rangsit Boutique & Budget Hotel?
faq.a: B2 Rangsit is at 48/121 Moo 1, Phahonyothin Road, Khlong Nueng, Khlong Luang District, Pathum Thani — a B2-chain budget hotel in the Khlong Luang-Rangsit area, right on Phahonyothin Road and easy to access. It's near Bangkok University (about 4 km), Future Park Rangsit and Thammasat University's Rangsit campus, and about a 25-minute drive from Don Muang Airport.

faq.q: How much does B2 Rangsit cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Prices start around ฿550/night for a Superior room. There's a choice of Superior Premier and Deluxe Premier (double bed), plus a Deluxe Triple that sleeps three — good for families. Rates rise by season and room type, so compare a few platforms before booking.

faq.q: Does B2 Rangsit have breakfast and parking?
faq.a: There's no breakfast, so you'll head out to eat — but a 7-Eleven is close by plus eateries on Phahonyothin Road. Parking is available but limited, so if you're self-driving at a busy time, arrive earlier or ask the front desk ahead.

faq.q: What are the rooms at B2 Rangsit like — is it quiet?
faq.a: Rooms are known for being new and clean for the price, since the hotel only opened in 2024, with comfortable beds. Bear in mind sound insulation between rooms isn't great — you may hear door locks and hallway noise — and the rooms are on the small side. If you're a light sleeper, bring earplugs.

faq.q: Who is B2 Rangsit best for?
faq.a: It's a strong fit for budget travelers who still want a new, clean room in Rangsit, parents dropping students at the nearby universities, and travelers stopping overnight before an early Don Muang flight. It scores a high 8.6 from real reviews — excellent for this price band — just go in prepared on noise and room size.
